notes.title: Skeletal Skism 2 Announced!
notes.content:
[b]Skeletal Skism 2 will be released on September 9th, 2024![/b]

This sequel to Skeletal Skism will include: new & interesting mechanics, new items, better visual effects, a dedicated single-player mode apart from the already existing (and improved) training mode, and many other improvements.

It will be [b]free to play[/b], so [b]wishlist it on Steam![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915050/Skeletal_Skism_2/

[url=https://discord.gg/UmVzv9dDkU]MBE Games Discord[/url]

notes.title: Monthly Championship #6 Results
notes.content:
[h3]On July 2nd, 2022, war broke out between the undead... [/h3]
[h3]In the end, one king emerged. [/h3]
[h3]Their name will be forever immortalized in the history of the Skeletal Skism.[/h3]

[h2]Skeleton King: [b]JackkingLord[/b][/h2]


[i]Next in line:[/i]

Skeleton Prince: [b]earlobe[/b]


Join the Discord server here: [url=https://discord.gg/UmVzv9dDkU]MBE Games Discord[/url]

notes.title: v4.0.0
notes.content:
- Mallet: Knockback increased from 0.5 to 0.7
- Hammer: Knockback increased from 1 to 1.4
- Quake: Knockback increased from 2 to 2.8

- Buckler: Tenacity increased from 0.2 to 0.4
- Shield: Tenacity increased from 0.4 to 0.8
- Bulwark: Tenacity increased from 0.8 to 1.6

- Added a new mechanic to fix a bug that occurred when multiple attacks landed on a unit at the same tick. Now, if multiple attacks land on a unit at the same tick, the attacks are completed in the following order [from first to last]: Angel, King, Ranged, Melee

- Rule 25 is now Rule 27
- Added a new rule (Rule 25)

([url=https://discord.gg/UmVzv9dDkU]MBE Games Discord[/url])

notes.title: Skeletal Skism Monthly Championship #6
notes.content:
The next official tournament for Skeletal Skism is the 6th Monthly Championship happening July 2nd, 2022 at 6PM PST!

No entry fee. 
1st place = $10 + 1000 Robux
2nd place = $5

1st and 2nd place will also receive special roles in the official MBE Games Discord server that will have to be defended each month. 

In addition, the winner will be permanently noted in the championship history.

In order to compete in the championship, you must be in the MBE Games Discord server.


Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/UmVzv9dDkU]MBE Games Discord[/url]
This event is sponsored by [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC-VyvQGCcbocEV7owhNJYNg]DukeRBX[/url]


(The end time listed is the latest possible time the championship could end and is subject to change as players register/unregister.)

notes.title: Advanced Training Mode!
notes.content:
The advanced training mode has just been added to Skeletal Skism!

After turning it on in the options, you will be able to buy items for the bot and even summon the green angel of death during single-player training mode.
